scope: Pure matrix multiplication on verified larger-LLM-derived shapes with synthetic Gaussian BF16 inputs; no real weights, real activations, epilogues, attention, model quality or end-to-end model performance.
hardware_stage: v5e first on one identified existing allocation; v6e only in a later separate replication.
shape_order: model, increasing M, gate_up_concat then down; execution order must be frozen by campaign separately.

input_distribution.name: gaussian
input_distribution.generation_order: A then B in host float32; quantize each once to BF16 before every arm/reference.
input_distribution.seed_policy: Screen and independent confirmation seeds must be explicit in frozen campaign; identical operands across arms within each shape and stage.
input_distribution.limitations: One fixed distribution is a performance input scope, not a guarantee on cancellation-sensitive or real model data.

comparison_requirements.tile_budget: Equal preregistered candidate attempts for cubic and Strassen, with per-shape independent selection and fresh confirmation. Exact six-candidate list owned by campaign runner.
comparison_requirements.failures: Retain unsupported/OOM/nonfinite/numerical failures, never silently omit or change tolerances.
comparison_requirements.numerical_scope: Use frozen MM correctness gate on exact quantized operands; disclose sampling scope and use all K for sampled references.

models.config_verification: Official config response bytes read and SHA256 computed; no checkpoint weight download.

interpretation_limits: Model configuration dimensions do not make random matrices actual checkpoint weights or activations.
Concatenated gate/up is one chosen matrix layout; it does not measure the cost or benefit of an official model fusion.
Gemma3-12B linear RoPE and multimodal model execution are outside the current Gemma1B adapter qualification; shape-only MM requires neither.
Qwen3-8B and Mistral7B share hidden_size4096 but have different intermediate widths12288 and14336.
No full model or three-model quality claim can be made from this manifest.

memory_policy.preflight_owner: Frozen campaign/runner validates padded arms and overhead before TPU execution.
memory_policy.reference: Bounded sampled rows/columns with all K; no full giant output reference. All output finite check remains device-side.
memory_policy.caution: Logical operand/output estimate alone does not certify compiled VMEM/HBM peak; retain OOM/unsupported records and serialize timings.
